class.name: CgameRetargeter
class.brief_description: Humanoid bone-name mapping and pose transfer.
class.description: [CgameRetargeter] maps bone names of different humanoid conventions (Mixamo, Biped, Blender DEF, VRM, plain names) to canonical keys such as [code]hips[/code], [code]upperleg|l[/code] or [code]hand|r[/code], builds source-to-target bone maps and transfers poses between rigs with different proportions. A "rig" dictionary has [code]names[/code] ([PackedStringArray]), [code]parents[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]), [code]rest[/code] ([PackedVector3Array], global rest positions) and optionally [code]rest_rot[/code] (local rest [Quaternion]s). A "pose" has [code]rot[/code] (an array of global or local rotations as documented per method) and [code]hips[/code]. For live skeletons use [method rig_from_skeleton], [method build_skeleton_map] and [method transfer_pose]. [codeblock] var map := CgameRetargeter.build_skeleton_map(source_skeleton, target_skeleton) CgameRetargeter.transfer_pose(source_skeleton, target_skeleton, map) [/codeblock]

method.name: build_map
method.description: Returns a dictionary mapping source bone indices to target bone indices. Each target bone is used at most once; unmatched bones fall back to an exact name match.

method.name: build_skeleton_map
method.description: Same as [method build_map] using the bone names of two skeletons.

method.name: canonical
method.description: Returns the canonical key of a bone name, with a side suffix [code]|l[/code] or [code]|r[/code], or an empty string if the bone is not recognized. [param aliases] maps custom names to canonical keys.

method.name: find_bone
method.description: Returns the index of the first bone whose canonical key is [param key], or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: fk
method.description: Forward kinematics of local pose rotations on a rig. Returns [code]pos[/code] and global [code]rot[/code] per bone.

method.name: ik_correct_feet
method.description: Adjusts the leg rotations so that feet reach [param foot_targets] (foot bone index to world position) using two-bone IK. Returns [code]rot[/code], [code]hips[/code], [code]pos[/code] and the largest remaining [code]error[/code].

method.name: retarget_pose
method.description: Copies mapped rotations to the target rig and scales the hips translation by the leg length ratio. Returns [code]rot[/code], [code]hips[/code] and [code]ratio[/code].

method.name: rig_from_skeleton
method.description: Creates a rig dictionary from a skeleton.

method.name: transfer_pose
method.description: Transfers the current pose of [param source] to [param target]: each mapped bone keeps its rotation relative to its own rest pose, and the hips translation is scaled by the leg length ratio when [param scale_hips] is [code]true[/code]. Returns the number of transferred bones.
